correctness.rationale: Assari–Hosseinzadeh–Macpherson identify N4's automorphism group with the unique homogeneous 4-branching D-set and describe D via unrooted trees. Finite injective tuple types are therefore reduced leaf-labelled trees of internal degree 3 or 4. Rooting at a fixed labelled leaf gives the species equation R=x+R^2/2+R^3/6. Exhaustive recursive generation through seven rooted leaves, the recurrence, and Lagrange inversion agree.
